_meta.name: Resident population age 65 and older
_meta.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
_meta.note: Computed from all-sexes age-65-and-older counts divided by all-sexes total resident population. Vintage list: 2000–2010 intercensal estimates for 2000–2009; 2010–2020 intercensal estimates for 2010–2019; Vintage 2025 estimates for 2020–2025. Newer vintage wins at 2010 and 2020. A22 compares April 1 census/base observations at the same dates, allowing 0.3 years or 0.2 percentage points. 1970–1999 extension DEFERRED: the linked 1970s workbook https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/tables/1900-1980/national/asrh/pe-11-1970s.xls returned HTTP 200 but its title specifies Resident Population plus Armed Forces Overseas, unlike the resident-only series here, and provides single-year ages rather than a published median. The 1990s table https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/tables/1990-2000/national/totals/nat-agesex.txt returned HTTP 200 text/html with Request Rejected: The requested URL was rejected. Its linked nat-agesex-doc.txt returned HTTP 404, U.S. Census Bureau: Page not found. The 1980s dataset page links quarterly age/race/sex ZIP files, but their resident-only annual extraction and derived-median methodology have not been validated. Resolution requires verified resident-only annual age distributions and a documented median derivation, or published historical resident medians/shares. No historical values are interpolated.
_meta.annualRule: July 1 resident population estimate; one observation per calendar year.
_meta.breaks: Intercensal/vintage splice at 2010 and 2020; census-base revisions can change estimates. July annual estimates are not replaced by April census/base observations.
